perfil_profesional: I am a Doctor of Medicine with a Neuroscience Research Emphasis from Universidad del Rosario. Additionally, I am a Specialist and I hold a Master´s degree in Medical Education from both Universidad del Rosario and Universidad Javeriana in Bogotá, with training in surgical neuroanatomy from Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México and anatomical dissection techniques from Universidad de los Andes. I got my PMP®️certification from PMI in United States and I passed the USMLE Step 1 in my journey of becoming a ECFGM certificated Doctor in the United States. I am passionate about the nervous system, neurosurgery, and innovation in medical education through technology. Currently, I work as a Faculty Member at the School of Medicine and Health Sciences at Universidad del Rosario,and on my own technological Star Up: Lecture Series I am also an avid learner about various fields of knowledge, including mathematics, natural sciences, computer science, 3D printing, 3D modeling, Project Management and entrepreneurship.
